purpose: Store an anonymous 'what was I offered' report and return how it compares with the local range (drives the thank-you screen).
notes: Never store a user id on the report. If a shop token is sent, store only its partnerId.
Set flagged=true when offeredPrice < 0.2 x median or > 3 x median. Store it, but leave it out of aggregates until an NGO verifies it.
gapPct = round((median - offeredPrice) / median * 100). Positive means below the median.
position: 'below' if offeredPrice < min, 'above' if > max, otherwise 'within'.
Rate-limit by IP, for example 10 per hour.
